placement.note: frame_of(u3) angles; the web (108.6 deg of uncut ring) sits under link 2's ring wherever it lands - the groove is inside the O20 ring (r 6.45..8.55, walls 0.95 to the bearing seat / 1.45 to the rim), never in the bar

tolerance.drawing: true position 0.02 (+-0.01 tangential) on the dowel hole and both groove end-arc centres, relative to the J3 bore and each part's angular datum; groove walls concentric to the J3 bore within 0.02
tolerance.acceptance: -112.40 <= J3MIN <= -111.25 and 119.85 <= J3MAX <= 123.78, read on the J3 encoder at assembly
tolerance.verdict: fits: worst 0.21 in / 0.26 out inside the 0.74 / 0.585 held margins at +-0.01; +-0.02 (0.41) still fits; ISO 2768-f (0.87) fails

dowel_calc.note: 440C 58 HRC yield ~1900 MPa (shear 0.58 x); bearing on the Ti-6Al-4V groove end over the 0.85 mm engagement (projected; the red team rates it on Fbry ~1.3 GPa: SF 1.66 at 10 N.m); the single-dowel force returns through J3's MR117 pair as a radial load, 155 N per N.m on bearing 1 (C0r ~280 N): s0 = 1 at 1.81 N.m about J3 - the stop's rating; the cuff (slips ~1.06 N.m) is the torque fuse (docs/research/conecut_mechanism_redteam.md section 1-2; the same caveat as every gen-4..7 single-dowel stop)

bottom.plane: square to the arm (normal = the model's sa), the L1's cut

upper_cuff.wrap_rule: each side arc stops 1.0 mm before the first trunk point within 1.0 mm of it over 451 clip poses

base.rule: base at the J1 hub ring, no tab (user 2026-10-16); NO ears: link 1 sweeps every ear heading (see diag)
base.interface: the handler's bracket threads onto the J1 M18 x 0.5 spigot in place of the dome cap (retains the upper outer ring)
